A '''picture''' of a [[Unidentified female Jedi Master (meditation)|female Jedi Master]] [[Meditation/Legends|meditating]] was present on one of the walls of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia's]] [[Jedi enclave (Corellia)|Jedi enclave]]. In [[41 ABY]], when [[New Jedi Order]] [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] visited the [[Jedi academy|Jedi Enclave]], [[Gender/Legends|he]] saw the picture.<ref name="Betrayal">''[[Legacy of the Force: Betrayal]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The picture of a meditating female [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] first appeared in [[Aaron Allston]]'s novel [[Legacy of the Force: Betrayal]], the first entry in the [[Star Wars: Legacy of the Force]] series.
